title: Elucidating the role of PdAgFe charge transfer in ternary aerogels for boosting electro-oxidative degradation of recalcitrant di-butyl phthalate
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29661-29673
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00270F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sammia Khurshid, Muzammil Anjum, Rab Nawaz, Sahar Saleem, Marlia Mohd Hanafiah, Azeem Khalid, Muhammad Umair
This study reports ternary PdAgFe aerogels for electro-oxidative degradation of DBP in water. The aerogels achieved 97% DBP removal with enhanced charge transfer and improved oxidation potential for efficient pollutant degradation.
